content_sections.heading: ICAR CIAE Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional - II: Master's degree from a recognized university with a minimum of 60% marks, in accordance with ICAR guidelines. Young Professional - I: Bachelor's degree / Diploma from a recognized university with a minimum of 60% marks, in accordance with ICAR guidelines.

content_sections.heading: ICAR CIAE Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 45 years Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PH as per rules.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CIAE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CIAE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional posts at ICAR CIAE is scheduled for 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: For Young Professional - II, a Master's degree with a minimum of 60% marks is required. For Young Professional - I, a Bachelor's degree or Diploma with a minimum of 60% marks is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for all Young Professional posts is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for ICAR CIAE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Young Professional - II will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 42,000/- per month, while Young Professional - I will receive Rs 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Young Professional posts, with 2 for Young Professional - II and 1 for Young Professional - I.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ICAR Central Institute of Agricultural Engineering located?
faq.answer: The ICAR Central Institute of Agricultural Engineering is located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 641007.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is prior online application required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview, so no prior online application is required. Candidates can directly attend the interview.
